newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a limited test, USDA said. Buyer inquiry was only fair and seller interest minimal as the vast majority have already traded their showlists. Confirmed- 1,200 Last Week - 3,400 Last Year - 7,800
Wk To Date- 107,200 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 51,700 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 35,600

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs - 105.00-106.00, ( weighted average 105.83 ). Two loads Select and Choice 2-3 1300 lb Holsteins 102.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1225 lbs - 105.00-106.00, ( weighted average 105.76).
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)

For the Week - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis were $0.50-$1.00 per cwt higher; dressed basis mostly $1.00 higher. The week's total includes 9,200 previously contracted or formulated cattle.

Most packers entered the week "short bought", and by Tuesday afternoon were pushed to get cattle around them to complete this week's kill. The demand became good enough to not only clean up the current showlists, but also the large number of cattle carried over from last week, and to do so at higher money. Seller interest matched the demand, and by end of the session, showlists were depleted.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1175-1325 lbs - Through the week, and at the close mostly 65.00-66.00, ( weighted average 65.65 ); dressed basis mostly 105.00-106.00. ( weighted average 105.26).

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1250 lbs - Through the week, and at the close mostly 65.00-66.00 ( weighted average 65.28 ); dressed basis mostly 105.00-106.00. ( weighted average 105.23).
